name: Morgenbrief — Nord-Norge
_max_items_note: 25 -> 30 on 2026-10-05 with per_beat_min, so the six reserved world items do not cost the regional beats their slots.
_exclude_beats_note: US midterm items have their own daily brief (midterm-brief); in the morning brief they would crowd the regional beats and say nothing about Norway.
_per_beat_min_note: Reserve the top six `verden` hits (world news a news director must know, regardless of Norway) before the global fill, for the brief's «Verden» section. Same mechanism as the international brief's per_region_min; see plugins/loaders/db.py.
